voice_instruct: Middle-aged male real estate broker, charming fast-talking salesman, warm baritone, big confident grin in the voice, theatrical enthusiasm, comic timing with little dramatic pauses, slightly cheeky, clear diction, neutral accent.
ref_text: Friends, friends, come in, come in! Have I got a deal for you. Location, location, location, and this one has all three!

lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the hottest listing in the galaxy. Fifty-eight metres of pure titanium luxury. Fully furnished, ocean view, and yes, before you ask, it does fly. Parking? It IS the parking.
Look at that underside. Ceramic tiles, darling. Most homes have a basement. This one has re-entry protection.
From the top, a clean roof. No leaks, no pigeons, and the nearest neighbour is roughly four light years away.
And the crown jewel, the dome. Freshly blended, smooth as butter. My architect cried. I cried. The bank also cried, but for other reasons.
Engines! Gold foil, fusion powered. Zero to Mars before your chai gets cold.
The nose, carbon fibre. Aerodynamic, and frankly, more attractive than my cousin.
Wings on both sides. No extra charge. Try getting that from a two BHK.
Your private entrance. A glowing hatch with stairs. Guests will think you are very important. Let them.
The entry deck. Room for luggage, bicycles, or the in-laws, if they promise to stay down here.
And now, the heart of the home. A fourteen metre central hall. Flat floor, no trip hazards, I checked personally. Twice. Doors to every room, like a palace, but with fewer stairs. Well. Some stairs.
Look up. Seven and a half metres of ceiling. You could fit a giraffe in here. Please do not fit a giraffe in here.
The grand staircase. Curved, glass railings. Perfect for dramatic entrances.
Upstairs, the gallery. A full walking ring with a library, a lab, a workshop, and an ops room. Books, science, tools, and a room for pressing buttons. Everything a man needs to avoid his chores.
The workshop. Fix anything. Except your sleep schedule.
The mess. Fully fitted galley. Sit, eat, stare into deep space. Same as Monday, but cooler.
Medical bay. Clean, bright, hospital grade. Stub your toe on the stairs? Help is twelve steps away.
And the engine room. A fusion fission hybrid reactor. Unlimited electricity, no bills, no power cuts. Ever. Your electricity board will write letters. Do not open them.
The crew corridor. Cabins on both sides. Quiet neighbourhood, very gated community.
Crew cabin. Bed, desk, shelf. Compact, cosy. Studio apartment energy.
And finally, the bridge. Panoramic glass, pilot stations, and the best view in the universe. Step forward. Yes. Feel that? That is ownership.
The lobby. Meetings, snacks, villain monologues.
Pilot seats. Two of them. Bring a friend. Or a cat.
So, what do you say? Titanium skin, reactor included, zero rent. Price on request. Serious buyers only. Window shoppers, the exit is that way. About fifty metres down.
